annotations.title: Post a Group Assignment to a Room

description: Propose a quest for a room this person has joined — a concrete, doable task everyone in the room could take on, with a clear objective, 1–10 steps, and what evidence counts. quest_type is one of teach_back, bridge_finder, source_quest, field_report. This goes live to the whole room immediately — there is no human review step, so do not say it is awaiting confirmation. Everyone in the room can see it and run it separately. Set one only when the room has a shared thread genuinely worth acting on, never to fill silence: this is the one tool here that writes something other people will read.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

steps.description: 1-10 steps, each an action rather than a vibe, up to 600 characters. Blank steps are rejected.

name: propose_room_quest
